summary: Strong neon-night mood in the boulevard, arcade and tunnel: dense lit towers, readable Chinese meme neon, the P5 calling-card mural, rain, the convenience store and the finish screen. No runtime errors, 60 fps, and the city files typecheck clean. It is not yet at a polished commercial bar. The wet-road reflection breaks into sawtooth bands across about 40 % of every chase frame. Oversized additive lamp pools wash out the road and blow out the tunnel floor, so the white pelican loses contrast. Street-level facades look like pale pastel lightboxes. The riverside is half empty. The sprint has no billboard canyon. The P5 red/black identity is thin, and the trees read as purple and brown blobs. 7 major, 5 minor. Shots are in shots/review/env-city/r1-art/.

issues.title: Wet-road reflections alias into horizontal sawtooth 'comb' bands
issues.detail: The bottom ~40 % of every chase frame is the reflection overlay. It breaks into zig-zag, interlace-like bands and blocky low-res steps instead of smooth wet-asphalt streaks (a_40.png + c_a40_roadL.png, c_a760_road.png, c_gantryS.png, d_crest.png). Cause: env/city-wet.ts FRAG shifts uv.x by vnoise(vWorld.xz*1.7 + t). That frequency is in world space, so distant rows get several noise cycles per pixel row. The mirror target (env/city-mirror.ts) is only 0.4x the canvas on high, and it is smeared vertically (spread 0.055) with almost no horizontal filtering (0.0025). The result reads as a glitchy flooded lake, not stylised wet asphalt.
issues.fix: Make the ripple frequency distance-aware: scale the noise coordinate by 1/(1+vDepth*0.15), or fade the displacement with fwidth(vWorld.xz). Cut the amplitude to ~0.0015. Raise the RoadMirror scale to 0.6 on high (0.4 on medium) and add 2-3 horizontal taps (+-0.0015) to the 9-tap kernel. Clamp the spread at grazing angles so streaks stay vertical and soft. Add a low-frequency dry-patch/roughness mask so 30-40 % of the asphalt shows its own albedo and lane paint.

issues.title: Lamp light pools are 14 m discs that wash the road and tunnel floor to peach/white haze
issues.detail: street.ts calls pools.add(..., 7, ...), a 7 m radius every ~26 m on each side. The additive discs overlap into a near-continuous peach/white haze over most of the road (a_480, a_680, a_1240, b_1750, e_kerb.png). On the crest they turn into stretched, hard-edged stickers (d_crest.png). underpass.ts adds 3.6 m pools every 9 m on both sides. The tunnel floor measures a mean luminance of 151/255 against ~45 on the streets, so the white pelican almost vanishes (b_2340.png, d_tunnel.png). This kills the night contrast the brief asks for and hurts hero readability.
issues.fix: Use a 3-4 m radius (4.5 m max on wide plazas) and halve the colour. Give the pool texture a hot core with a steep falloff (alpha ~ (1-d^2)^3). In the tunnel, use one pool per ceiling lamp every ~18 m at colour (0.35,0.32,0.28), or none at all since the LED strips already light it. Skip pools where vertical curvature is high (crest/drop). Keep hero-to-road luminance contrast above about 3:1.

issues.title: Street-level facades read as pale pastel lightboxes
issues.detail: The shop-glass style in dressing/city/glsl.ts (style 4) forces lit = 1, uses pastel tints x 0.55 and draws its shelves as 3 flat brightness steps. Together with fully lit cool office floors, it makes large uniform lilac/beige/white planes at exactly the height the chase camera sees most (a_40, c_a760_left.png, c_a760_right.png, b_2765, b_3010, g_sprintChase.png). Near buildings end up brighter and flatter than the mid-ground towers, so the neon loses its pop and the street drifts toward a pastel dusk mall. This misses the brief's bar: 'strong colour contrast ... no flat-lit boxes'.
issues.fix: Shop branch: use a dark interior base (value <= 0.25), light only 50-65 % of bays (hash h), add 2-3 silhouette rects per bay (shelves, shoppers, posters) and a brighter ceiling light strip, and drop bright to ~0.3. Styles 2/3 near the street: cap the lit ratio at ~0.35-0.5, keep unlit glass deep navy, and raise window saturation (amber vs cyan) so facades read dark with lit accents.

issues.title: Riverside: half of the chase frame is an empty void
issues.detail: For ~400 m (s 1640-1936 and 2076-2186), the river side of the view is flat purple sky and grey clouds over open water. There is no far bank, no skyline and no lights, and the navy water with white flecks reflects none of the neon (b_1750.png, move_0..7.png, f_across.png, d_bridgeSide.png). The postcard collapses to one side of the screen for the whole stretch.
issues.fix: Build a far-bank skyline 250-450 m across the water: farfill-style blocks with the window shader, a few tall towers with neon crowns and rooftop screens, and a lit ferry pier. Give the water vertical colour-streak reflections, either by rendering the river through RoadMirror/REFLECT_LAYER or with cheap additive streak quads under the bright towers. Suppress the white foam flecks at night.

issues.title: Final sprint has no 'canyon of billboards'
issues.detail: The brief's climax (sprint, s 2918-3218, into the finish screen) looks like every other avenue: low shophouses with pale glass, ginkgo blobs and a few small fascia signs. The only big screens sit high on distant towers (b_3010, b_3160, g_sprintUp.png, g_sprintChase.png). The blocks.ts header promises 'a billboard canyon on the sprint', but the sprint zone config and slots don't produce one.
issues.fix: In the sprint zone, place 6-10 large LED screens (BILLBOARDS.city art) per side at 4-16 m height, stacked and staggered on facades and scaffolds, yawed 10-20 deg toward the rider, with neon frames plus a couple of P5 red/black boards. Drop the planter trees there so the walls of screens frame the finish gantry.

issues.title: P5 red/black accents are almost absent from the chase view
issues.detail: The brief asks for 'huge red/black P5 accents' (SPEC 5: 'P5-Tokyo vibe with red accents'). In game the world is purple/lavender/cyan. Red appears only on bollards, a few signs, the gantry slashes, the single calling-card mural and the underpass posters. P5 boards use only 1 of every 4 rooftop slots (neon.ts roof: k % 4 === 2), and most sit above the camera's view (a_250, a_580, a_1240, b_2870). The city reads as generic synthwave cyberpunk rather than this game's P5 identity.
issues.fix: Add eye-level P5 set dressing every ~150-250 m: tall red/black diagonal banners down tower corners, jagged red star-burst boards and ransom-note signs on street walls facing the road, red/black hazard-chevron fascia on the viaduct and tunnel portals, and P5 card posters on shutters. Move ~20 % of fascia/blade neon to #E5191C/white with black frames.

issues.title: Planter trees render as purple 'broccoli' and brown 'potatoes'
issues.detail: planterTree in scenery/props/city-street.ts multiplies pink/gold colours by 2.3 for a lamp-lit look. Under the toon ramp and night grade they land in the shadow band instead: cherries read dull violet and ginkgos brown-olive (c_a250_left.png, b_2650, b_3010, e_trees.png, e_kerb.png). Each canopy is 4 overlapping 7x5-segment spheres (visibly faceted) on a 0.13 m trunk, so it looks like a lump floating at head height. They repeat along every street and the final sprint.
issues.fix: Give canopies an emissive/unlit term, or move them to the glow batch at ~0.6 intensity with a toon rim, so they really read pink and gold. Use smooth icospheres (detail 2+) or merged blob clusters with smoothed normals and a darker underside, and 0.2 m trunks with a fork. Use fewer trees on the sprint.

issues.title: Scramble crossing stripes barely read from the chase cam
issues.detail: The scramble's X-crossings are crisp from above (c_scramble.png). At chase height they are lavender on lavender and broken up by the reflection and sheen (a_760, c_a760_road.png), so the 'zebra stripes everywhere' set piece is lost.
issues.fix: Paint the stripes near-white (value ~0.9, slightly emissive), mask the wet overlay's sheen/reflection to ~40 % over paint, and add lit signal heads facing the road at the four corners.

issues.title: Roundabout monument is a small brown blob
issues.detail: The 'gilded pelican on a bike' (city-statue.ts) reads as a dull brown lump on a plain lilac drum. The island is dark green with random coloured cubes (d_statue.png). As the hairpin's visual anchor it has no silhouette and no glint.
issues.fix: Scale it 1.5-2x and make it read as real gold (warm yellow base, bright toon highlight, rim). Put it on a pedestal with a neon ring and a P5 plaque, add 2-4 uplight glows, and swap the confetti cubes for flower beds or low hedges.

issues.title: Arcade 'paper lanterns' are glowing cubes
issues.detail: lanternStrings in life.ts builds each lantern as a 0.34 x 0.46 x 0.34 box (c_a900_top.png, a_900). They read as floating yellow and red boxes, not lanterns.
issues.fix: Use a bulged lathe/cylinder (8 segments) with dark top and bottom caps and a tassel, sized 0.35-0.55 m.

issues.title: Night-market gate subtitle collides with the title
issues.detail: gateFace in faces.ts draws the title at h*0.42 at size h*0.56, reaching down to ~0.70h. 'NIGHT MARKET' starts at ~0.70h (h*0.8, size h*0.2), so the two neon-tube glows overlap (c_a1040_gate.png).
issues.fix: Put the title at 0.38h, size 0.46h, and the subtitle at 0.84h, size 0.15h, or use a 640x160 cell.

issues.title: cross-unit: night clouds read as flat grey cut-outs
issues.detail: The shared sky clouds (env/sky.ts, owned by the track unit) stay mid-grey with dark outlines even with the city's 0.84 lerp to sky.top. They float at rooftop height and dominate the expressway and riverside skies, clashing with the purple palette (c_a1420_clouds.png, a_1590, b_1750).
issues.fix: For the night look, darken the clouds to indigo (value ~0.15) with a magenta/orange underglow from the city and raise them about 1.5x, or hide them in the city since it is overcast and raining.
